title: Fish, Acute Toxicity Testing
species: Freshwater, estuarine, and marine fish species (e.g., Zebrafish, Fathead minnow, Rainbow trout)
dose_groups: At least 5 concentrations in a geometric series (plus control(s))

title: Acute Dermal Toxicity: Fixed Dose Procedure
dose_groups: 1 animal for range-finding; 2 animals for main study steps
route: Sequential single-dose groups based on fixed dose levels (50, 200, 1000, 2000 mg/kg)

title: Chronic Toxicity Studies
species: Rat (preferred); other rodent species; non-rodents possible
animals: At least 20 per sex per group (rodents)

title: Acute Inhalation Toxicity
species: Rat (preferred); other species may be used with justification
duration: Generally 4 hours exposure; observation period up to 14 days
animals: Sighting: 3/sex; Main Study: 5/sex (Traditional) or 1-2/sex/time point (C x t)
dose_groups: At least 3 concentrations (Main study) or Limit test (single concentration)
route: Inhalation (Nose-only preferred; Whole-body allowed with justification)

title: Skin Sensitisation Guinea Pig Maximisation Test and Buehler Test
species: Guinea pig (Male and/or female healthy young adult animals; females should be nulliparous and non-pregnant)
duration: Induction period (10-14 days) + Challenge observation (approx. 3 days); Total approx. 3-4 weeks
animals: GPMT: Min 10 treated, 5 control; Buehler: Min 20 treated, 10 control
dose_groups: At least 1 test group and 1 control group (Vehicle only). Pilot studies recommended for dose selection.

title: Uterotrophic Bioassay in Rodents: A short-term screening test for oestrogenic properties
species: Rat (preferred); Mouse may be used with rationale
dose_groups: Minimum of 2 treatment groups + 1 control group

title: Avian Dietary Toxicity Test
species: Mallard duck, Bobwhite quail, Pigeon, Japanese quail, Ring-necked pheasant, Red-legged partridge
duration: Minimum 8 days (5 days exposure + 3 days recovery)
animals: 10 birds per group (2 control groups, at least 5 treatment groups)
dose_groups: At least 5 dietary levels + 2 control groups

title: Hershberger Bioassay in Rats: A Short-term Screening Assay for (Anti)Androgenic Properties
dose_groups: Min 2 test groups (androgenic) or 3 test groups (antiandrogenic) + controls

title: Acute Dermal Irritation/Corrosion
duration: Up to 14 days observation period (exposure normally 4 hours)

title: Acute Oral Toxicity – Acute Toxic Class Method
species: Rat (preferred); other rodent species may be used
duration: Observation period of 14 days (single dose administration)
animals: 3 animals of a single sex (normally females) per step
dose_groups: Stepwise procedure using fixed doses (5, 50, 300, 2000 mg/kg); Limit test possible at 2000 or 5000 mg/kg

title: Prenatal developmental toxicity study
duration: From implantation to one day prior to scheduled delivery
animals: Sufficient to result in approx. 20 pregnant females with implantation sites (min 16)
dose_groups: At least 3 dose levels + 1 concurrent control group

title: Two-Generation Reproduction Toxicity Study
duration: At least 10 weeks pre-mating + mating period + gestation/lactation for F1; continues until F2 weaning
animals: Sufficient to yield preferably not less than 20 pregnant females at parturition
dose_groups: At least three dose levels and a concurrent control
